activity_noRecent_title.title: Nessuna attività di navigazione recente

activity_empty.title: I siti visitati di recente appariranno qui. Continua la navigazione per vedere quanti sistemi di tracciamento vengono bloccati.
activity_empty.note: Shown in the place a list of browsing history entries will be displayed.

activity_no_trackers.title: Nessun sistema di tracciamento trovato
activity_no_trackers.note: Placeholder message indicating that no trackers are detected

activity_no_trackers_blocked.title: Nessun sistema di tracciamento bloccato
activity_no_trackers_blocked.note: Placeholder message indicating that no trackers are blocked

activity_countBlockedPlural.title: {count} tentativi di tracciamento bloccati
activity_countBlockedPlural.note: New pill text indicating that more than 1 attempt has been blocked. Eg: '2 Tracking attempts blocked'. Uppercase T is by design

activity_countBlockedPluralLegacy.title: {count} tentativi di tracciamento bloccati
activity_countBlockedPluralLegacy.note: The main headline indicating that more than 1 attempt has been blocked. Eg: '2 tracking attempts blocked'

activity_countBlockedSingular.title: {count} tentativo di tracciamento bloccato
activity_countBlockedSingular.note: Pill text indicating that 1 attempt has been blocked. Eg: '1 Tracking attempt blocked'

activity_cookiePopUpBlocked.title: Pop-up dei cookie bloccato
activity_cookiePopUpBlocked.note: Pill text indicating that we have blocked cookie pop-ups

activity_noRecentAdsAndTrackers_subtitle.title: I siti visitati di recente appariranno qui. Continua la navigazione per vedere quanti annunci e sistemi di tracciamento blocchiamo.
activity_noRecentAdsAndTrackers_subtitle.note: Shown in the place a list of browsing history entries will be displayed.

activity_no_adsAndTrackers.title: Nessun annuncio + tentativi di tracciamento rilevati
activity_no_adsAndTrackers.note: Placeholder message indicating that no ads and trackers are detected

activity_no_adsAndTrackers_blocked.title: Nessun annuncio + tentativi di tracciamento bloccati
activity_no_adsAndTrackers_blocked.note: Placeholder message indicating that no ads and trackers are blocked

activity_countBlockedAdsAndTrackersPlura.title: {count} annunci + tentativi di tracciamento bloccati
activity_countBlockedAdsAndTrackersPlura.note: The main headline indicating that more than 1 attempt has been blocked. Eg: '2 ads + tracking attempts blocked'

activity_favoriteRemove.note: Button label, allows the user to remove the specified domain from their favorites

activity_itemRemove.title: Rimuovi {domain} dalla cronologia
activity_itemRemove.note: Button label for clearing browsing history for a given domain.

activity_burn.title: Cancella la cronologia di navigazione e i dati per {domain}
activity_burn.note: Button label for clearing browsing history and data exclusively for the specified domain

activity_menuTitle.title: Attività recente
activity_menuTitle.note: Used as a label in a customization menu

activity_show_more_history.title: Mostra altri {count}
activity_show_more_history.note: Button label that expands the list of browsing history with the specified count of additional items. Example: 'Show 5 more'

activity_show_less_history.title: Nascondi altro
activity_show_less_history.note: Button label that hides the expanded browsing history items.
